BEN.note: Only a beneficiary count for Benin; no authentication service stated.

BFA.note: Only a target for Burkina Faso; no authentication service stated.

NER.note: Only a target for Niger; no authentication service stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Togo's e-ID is integrated into the Novissi platform and is used to authenticate beneficiaries of ANADEB's cash transfer programmes.
The World Bank says Togo's national digital services gateway, social registry and social payments platform use the fID.

TGO.note: Data protection named only as part of a framework Togo has operationalised; no law, standing or authority stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Togo's social payments platform uses the fID and the Novissi platform serves ANADEB's cash transfer programmes.
The World Bank says the e-ID is used to authenticate beneficiaries of ANADEB cash transfers on the Novissi platform.

BEN.note: A count of UNIs received is given (about 9.6 million) but no share of the population.

BFA.note: Only a target; no enrolment share stated.

NER.note: Only a target; no enrolment share stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Togo's mass registration campaign has enrolled nearly 4 million people, 49% of the population, and delivered 2.6 million ID credentials against a target of 7 million.
The World Bank describes Togo's e-ID as a biometric ID system based on open-source technologies (MOSIP).

BEN.note: No register keyed on the ID stated.

BFA.note: No register keyed on the ID stated.

NER.note: No register keyed on the ID stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Togo's e-ID is fully interoperable with the dynamic social registry (RSPM), which automatically ingests biographic data and unique identification numbers.

BEN.note: No system status stated beyond a UNI count.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Togo's fID system is operational and generates unique identification numbers aligned with international standards.

TGO.note: A system aligned with international standards only; no standards body or rule stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Togo's e-ID is fully interoperable with the dynamic social registry (RSPM) and integrated into the Novissi platform.

TGO.note: No programme management information system described.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Togo has operationalised a dynamic social registry (RSPM) that its e-ID feeds.
The World Bank says the e-ID system is fully interoperable with the RSPM, enabling automatic ingestion of unique identification numbers.
